customer: Okay so I'm in the middle of moving to Aldora for a new job, boxes everywhere, and I'm selling my hybrid sedan to you as part of all this chaos. I still have a loan on it and my next payment is coming up soon, and honestly I'm not sure if I'm supposed to keep paying it now that you're handling the payoff or if I can just let it go. I really don't want to mess anything up on top of everything else going on.
agent: Congratulations on the new job! Please keep making your regular loan payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off. Our payoff covers the amount your lender quoted, and a missed payment in the meantime could be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, your lender will refund it to you, and you can find more on that in our article "Getting back an extra loan payment."
